eyebrow: From predicted scores to portfolio weights

code:
def build_weights(scores, inv_vol):
    ranks = scores.rank(pct=True)
    long_leg = ranks <= 1 / 3
    short_leg = ranks >= 2 / 3
    w = pd.Series(0.0, index=scores.index)
    w[long_leg] = inv_vol[long_leg] / inv_vol[long_leg].sum() * 0.5
    w[short_leg] = -inv_vol[short_leg] / inv_vol[short_leg].sum() * 0.5
    return w
caption: Each leg is capped so no single name exceeds 40% of that leg's weight.
